assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only chiramune:haru-aomi@light-novel#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional generation V1.0 cumulative monograph CHIRAMUNE_HARU_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese light novels: main Volumes 01-09 and the admitted narrative supplements it integrates (the V05 special-edition booklet, V06.5 and Days of Endless Summer). The V08 rough-illustration collection is excluded by the monograph as production paratext and Volume 09.5 is unopened. The Chiramune readings, longitudinal ledgers, specialist syntheses and other character monographs that also analyze Haru are not curated on this subject and were not used. The monograph's active_provisional status and its own current-model statements are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: V01-V03 are summarized only in the promotion statement; the base model is bound to V04 (prologue and epilogue focalization, captaincy crisis, Asuwayama, the kiss), followed by located revisions for V05 main, the V05 special edition (including first-year autumn retrospective and a V02-associated story), V06, V06.5, V07, V08 main, V09 and Days of Endless Summer, with paragraph-range locators for most claims. The monograph's sections are not in reading order (V09 and Days of Endless Summer precede V08 main and V07), so each section's current model is bound to its own boundary. Days of Endless Summer stories are retrospective testimony except its single present bridge, which the monograph places as current only after placement. Later states never revise earlier located behavior.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution); evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A governing account (section 1: effort as staying answerable to possibility; best act translation, worst act imposition), a stable-versus-state split (section 12), a named central contradiction with its discriminator (section 13: she returns Saku's jurisdiction because the Asuwayama process ends in his deliberation, but overclaims teammates' interiors because the hidden captaincy plan was built around compliance) and rejected rival readings (section 14). It predicts mistakes as well as care: the demon-captain compact and claim to see through teammates' accounts (V04 p-0023 to p-0025), collapse-level self-neglect (V04 p-0023 p0004-p0127), yanking the glove from Momiji and fleeing (V07 part0022 p0147-p0467), and treating basketball as her own field even from Yuzuki (V07 part0028). It also says what changes her response: whose decision a process serves, threats to partner uniqueness, and whether a domain can be made a fair contest (V06 p-0012 revises that self-theory for romance). It stops at team governance after V04, which no later section samples, and at unprompted emotional support requests.

Each revision ends in a bounded current model with locators: V04 imposition, dependence and an answerable but unanswered bid; V05 main challenge protocol and kejime (part0018 p0998 to part0020 p0026); V05 special-edition earlier challenge idiom and pre-pool attraction (V05S p-0053, p-0067); V06 romance-is-not-a-scored-contest and Atomu-mediated care (V06 p-0012, p-0022); V06.5 integration of love and elite basketball (V065 p-0030 to p-0034); V07 glove harm, repair and Yuzuki primacy shock; V08 ace-as-task and pursuit of a moving equal (V08 p-0013, p-0015); V09 reciprocal pitch adjustment and prior love for Yuzuki (V09 p-0016); Days of Endless Summer fair rivalry with Momiji and protection of Yuzuki's agency (DES p-0078). The account says what changes between states and why. Limits: V01-V03 are summarized, sections are out of reading order, and V05 main has no team-governance scene.

There is no voice or register section. The monograph does describe a recurring speech-act repertoire, located across states: wagers and challenges (the Asuwayama tied wager, the V05 special-edition request that Saku accept a future challenge, the V05 bounded request not to flee, the fair-fight idiom with Yuzuki and Momiji), direct naming of love, team-companion language (V06 p-0024) and blunt humor, flirtation and nicknames (section 10). Attested forms are few (`相棒`, `ダーリン`, kejime). Pronouns, address inventory, sentence endings and register shifts are not described.

Section 10 gives a bounded V01-V04 ordinary-life profile (appetite, food and exercise as intimacy, catch practice learned by repetition, sleeping undefended after exhaustion, accepting styling and a special-day dress, Asuwayama as a place for defeat and recalibration, meaning carried by glove and wristband), extended by the V05 swimsuit choice with Yuko and Yuzuki, V06 meal plans with Yuzuki and Days of Endless Summer food practice with Yua (DES p-0058). It is a trait list rather than an account of how routines adapt; home, family, schoolwork and solitary leisure are not sampled.

Relations are differentiated and located, and the account says what each changes: Saku (corrective equality, witness without decision authority at V04 p-0022 p0024-p0049, the deferred challenge protocol, running partner, reciprocal pitch adjustment); Yuzuki (an independently primary partner: the hidden compact, named rival in basketball and love, first container for scarcity pain, two primacy shocks, prior love at V09 p-0016 p0404-p0417, and protection of her agency at DES p-0078); teammates (imposition, walkout, admitted dependence and the 'missing twenty centimeters' request at V04 p-0032); Coach Misaki (adult critique, ace as task, the forced choice refused); Mai (structural superiority, the Mai-initiated call, technical teaching); Momiji (harm and repair, then fair rival); Yuko (styling help); Atomu (recruited for Saku). Transfer to an unsampled classmate or a non-sport adult is not established.

Interior content is located at most boundaries and causally drives located choices: the V04 prologue and epilogue fear of extinguished passion and the moon projection she later rejects (p-0010, p-0035), pre-pool attraction (V05S p-0067), the V06 private aside that team language is the only way she can be beside Saku, the named fear that basketball and love cost each other (V065 p-0030), the V07 recognition that she treated basketball as her own field, V08 experience of herself and teammates as pieces, V09 prior love for Yuzuki and the Days of Endless Summer marriage-and-children fantasy. The monograph flags that most of V04 is filtered through Saku and requires independent corroboration of his reading; V05 main interior is thin.

Located responses fall into conditioned families: against contempt or instrumental use of someone she values she intervenes directly (Wataya and the old team, V04 p-0017); when her standard of seriousness is contested she escalates hours and claims interior knowledge (V04 captaincy) until collapse forces admitted dependence; when partner uniqueness is threatened she lashes out and flees, then repairs through apology and changed shared practice (V07 part0022, part0024 p0038-p0052); against insult to what she values she converts heat into expanded play (V065 p-0032); against a rival's overclaim she corrects without denying the rival's influence (DES p-0078 p0564-p0608). Team conflict after V04 and conflict with adult authority beyond Coach Misaki are not sampled.

Located positions with their corrections: structural difference is real and effort guarantees no outcome (Mai, V04 p-0018 to p-0020); a stake in someone's choice is not authority over it (V04 p-0022); visible accuracy about teammates' conduct is not authority over their inner seriousness (the Misaki critique, V04 p-0025 p0088-p0100); a future request should not ask the other to wait (V05 part0020); romance cannot be made fair by procedure (V06 p-0012); love need not be purified away for sport (V065 p-0034, supplied by Misaki). The recognition-versus-command principle (section 11) organizes these, but weighing is seldom rendered and dilemmas outside consent, effort and rivalry are not sampled.

Play as competition is distributed and located: the Asuwayama wager, catch, one-on-ones and teasing with Yuzuki (V05S p-0074), the paired race (V09 p-0016), Yuzuki's use of play to make missing support visible (V04 p-0032) and fair contest with Momiji. Verbal humor is recorded only as 'blunt humor' and 'competitive humor' without content, style or suspension conditions.

One cumulative monograph covers main V01-V09 and three supplements with paragraph-range locators for most claims from V04 on. Gaps: V01-V03 summarized only, Volume 09.5 unopened, no voice section, sections out of order, V05 main and V08 thin on team method, generation V1.0 active_provisional. The readings, ledgers and syntheses that also analyze Haru are not curated on this subject.

Affirmative limits are located: Mai's superiority and the team's later loss block 'effort beats talent' (V04 p-0018 to p-0020); teammates' method objections are legitimate (section 14); Saku answers through support and a directed gesture, not matching love (V04 p-0027, p-0030), and no couple forms at any boundary; the V06.5 call is Mai-initiated, not Haru-originated dependence; the marriage fantasy is unheard and unadopted (DES p-0058); V09 disclosure is prompted (V09 p-0014); five rival readings are rejected as negative controls. All rest on one secondary artifact.

Each revision binds its current model to a named boundary with locators, and the monograph separates retrospective witness (V05 special-edition first-year autumn, Days of Endless Summer stories) from current transition and instructs placement before revising the current model. A reader must reorder the out-of-sequence sections, and V01-V03 are not separately stated.

scenario_readiness.note: Only a speech-act repertoire and a handful of attested forms are described; pronouns, address, endings and register are not. Generated lines would rest on situational description rather than a specified voice, which does not constrain output enough even for illustrative use. This bounds the evidence set, not Haru's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named boundary state: V04 captaincy (pre- or post-collapse), V05 main, V06, V06.5, V07 (pre- or post-repair), V08 main, V09 or the Days of Endless Summer present bridge; default post-V09. Earlier states do not import later corrections, and the V07 and V08 primacy shocks are not projected backward.

The interlocutor is Saku, Yuzuki, Momiji, Mai, Coach Misaki, Yuko, Yua, Atomu or the Fujishi teammates as located. Transfer to an unsampled classmate or adult is a separate, lower-confidence condition handled without invented history.
The situation is athletic practice or competition, partner rivalry, a challenge or wager, support for someone who has lost heat, or a threat to her place beside Saku or Yuzuki.
Team leadership after V04, unprompted emotional support requests, the enacted challenge to Saku, any romantic selection and her athletic vocation are output as open forks, never resolved.
Output is behavioral description, not quoted dialogue.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named monograph boundary state, defaulting to post-V09; earlier states only when selected, without importing later development; Days of Endless Summer retrospective stories are history, not later states.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Saku as running partner, catch partner and unanswered romantic object; Yuzuki as independently primary partner and fair rival; Momiji as harmed-then-repaired junior and fair rival; Mai and Coach Misaki as athletic superior and mentor; Fujishi teammates at located captaincy states; an unsampled peer only at lower confidence.
setting_constraints: High-school life: basketball practice and games, catch and running, Asuwayama, group outings
No adult, collegiate, corporate-league or occupational setting
No selection, couple status or Saku-side romantic declaration
Team-governance and support-request forks end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Readiness is conditional on one named state, a sampled relationship and the athletic, peer and romantic settings the monograph locates. Team governance after V04 and unprompted emotional support requests stay open.

conditions: Food, exercise, catch, running, styling and group outings with sampled interlocutors, using the section 10 profile and the located V05, V06 and Days of Endless Summer routines.
Glove, wristband and Asuwayama carry meaning as practical objects and places, never as ownership of a relationship.
Home, family, schoolwork and solitary leisure are not invented.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary life is located but thinner than her athletic and relational conduct.

conditions: Restricted to the located positions: effort versus guaranteed outcome, a stake versus decision authority, conduct versus inner seriousness, non-entitled future requests, fairness in romance, and love versus sport.
Each position is used at its own boundary state, including the pre-collapse V04 imposition when that state is selected.
A novel moral dilemma outside these positions is output as an open fork.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported only for restating located positions in closely analogous situations.

conditions: Her side only: repeated direct naming of love, the V04 kiss that leaves the next move to Saku, the V05 challenge protocol and kejime, V06 support below a present request, the V06.5 shot addressed to basketball and `ダーリン`, and fair rivalry with Yuzuki and Momiji.
Saku's side is limited to the located support, directed gesture, partner language and agreement not to flee; no matching love, selection, exclusivity or couple is invented at any boundary.
Through Days of Endless Summer the promised challenge is not enacted; she is not given it.
scenario_readiness.note: Her side of the romantic relation is extensively located; its outcome is not.

conditions: School-sport institutional roles only: Fujishi girls' basketball captain at the V04 states (mandate, hidden compact, expanded hours, walkout, collapse, admitted dependence) and ace under Coach Misaki at V08.
Whether post-V04 leadership is transparent or reverts to imposition is output as an open fork.
Recruitment, university, corporate-league and career logistics are not modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: School-sport institutional conduct is a center of the evidence at V04; later team governance is not sampled.

known_limits.statement: At every boundary through Days of Endless Summer, Saku answers Haru through support, partner language and a directed gesture, not matching love; no selection or couple forms, and her marriage-and-children imagery is unheard and unadopted.
The promised direct romantic challenge and the kejime it waits on remain unenacted and unexplained through Days of Endless Summer; every watchlist carries them open.

After V04 no section samples training negotiation, workload accountability, injury protocol or repair of the hidden compact; whether her dyadic consent practice generalizes to team leadership is affirmatively left open.
Mai's structural superiority and the team's later loss are located; effort does not guarantee outcomes and must not be modeled as doing so.
Through V09 Haru originates bounded shared tasks, but emotional disclosure is prompted and the V06.5 call is Mai-initiated; self-originated emotional support requests remain untested.
Most V04 evidence is filtered through Saku's focalization; the monograph treats his admiration as evidence about the relationship and requires independent conduct to corroborate it.
No register, address inventory or speech-style analysis exists in this evidence set beyond a speech-act repertoire and a few quoted forms.
Home, family, schoolwork and solitary leisure are not sampled in this evidence set.

The evidence is one active_provisional V1.0 monograph with V01-V03 summarized and Volume 09.5 unopened; no linked reading, ledger, synthesis or held-out validation is curated on this subject. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
